name: Taishi Kiyonori
source: Although his wacky lectures aren't very popular with his students, he isn't phased. His priority is his free time for hobbies, so he never works overtime. Even though at school he doesn't seem to have any ambitions... but his off-duty side is quite different?! You let your guard down when his sharp glare takes you by surprise. He steals your gaze and maybe your heart too.
